subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers ask the contributor to rebase and prove this PR on the current provider-auth helper, or adopt the fix in a fresh maintainer branch?
rationale: The branch is conflicting, the fix location is now wrong, and automation cannot supply the contributor's real Copilot credential-rotation proof or decide whether to adopt stale external work.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor port the cache ownership check to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, update current tests, and add redacted two-profile real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt in a fresh branch
options.body: A maintainer can open a narrow replacement PR against current main if the linked auth-provider bug is urgent or the source branch remains difficult to update.

options.title: Pause until contributor responds
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and close this PR later only if there is no rebase or proof after maintainer follow-up.

recommendation.title: Ask for rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor port the cache ownership check to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, update current tests, and add redacted two-profile real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the current assignee and has recent history in provider-auth and GitHub Copilot helper surfaces.
